posted_text:
👮 MA S3017 — Boston Could Hire an Older Officer

This bill asks Boston’s police department to consider hiring Elijah George Osborne, even if he’s older than the typical age limit for new officers.

The bill specifically says the department must waive its usual age rules for him if he meets all other qualifications.

The law would take effect immediately once it’s passed.

Aug. 6, 2026: Read; and referred to the committee on House Steering, Policy and Scheduling.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://malegislature.gov/Bills/194/S3017
